findings.title: Open SSH Port
findings.description: Port 22 is open with OpenSSH 8.9 running. Password authentication is enabled.
findings.remediation: Disable password authentication, use key-based auth only.

findings.title: Weak SSL Configuration
findings.description: TLS 1.0 and 1.1 are enabled. CBC cipher suites present.
findings.remediation: Disable TLS 1.0/1.1. Remove CBC cipher suites.
